project.name: namaa-tts-control-board
project.description: Local control board for Arabic TTS and zero-shot voice cloning across three switchable models: SILMA (Fusha/MSA), NAMAA Saudi and NAMAA Egyptian

environment.pythonVersionNote: Exactly 3.11 — silma-tts pins numpy<=1.26.4, which has no wheels for 3.12/3.13. The venv is provisioned with `uv venv --python 3.11`.
